messages:
maria: Quick follow-up after weekend alerts - multiple proxies stamped roles and our unioning produced accidental org:admin. Need a small, deterministic rule.
jon: Repro: client -> apigw -> ingress -> service. Mapper unions claims today.
li: Short-term: deterministic precedence in mapping service. Long-term: edge canonical envelope.
alex: Proposed precedence: service > operator > ingress > apigw > client. First-seen wins for a given (role,scope).
patrick: Ops asks: add provenance stamp, mapping_decisions_total, conflict_samples (0.1%), mapping_latency_ms. Also hard cap claims/request (200).
maria: Migration: Phase 0 shadow logs 2w; Phase 1 feature-flagged canary 10% 1w; Phase 2 rollout + 30d audit retention. Gating: no perf regressions and conflict_denied rate stable.
li: Edge cases: if operator/service send more-specific scope (project id) they may override wildcards; proxies/clients cannot escalate.
jon: I'll open mapping-service PR with shadow mode.
patrick: I'll wire dashboards and alerts.
sec-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/612 "claims-precedence-and-provenance".
maria: Thanks — drop repros into that issue and tag incident-421.
